parameters.formDescription: Submit a job posting. Matching students will be notified automatically. For skills / branches, enter comma-separated values (e.g. Python, Flask, SQL).

values.formSubmittedText: Thank you. Your job has been posted and eligible students are being notified.

// Emit only the recruiter sub-document for the insert node.
return [{ json: $input.first().json.recruiter }];

// Pull the normalized job from the validation node (survives the recruiter insert).
return [{ json: $('Validate & Normalize Job').first().json.job }];

const d = $json; const job = d.job || {}; const esc = (v) => String(v == null ? '' : v) .replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>'); const list = (arr) => Array.isArray(arr) && arr.length ? arr.map(esc).join(', ') : '—'; const subject = 'New Job Opportunity: ' + esc(job.jobTitle) + ' at ' + esc(job.companyName); const html = `

${esc(job.jobTitle)}

${esc(job.companyName)}

Hello ${esc(d.studentName)},

A new job opportunity has been posted that matches your profile.

Role${esc(job.role)}
Department${esc(job.department) || '—'}
Employment Type${esc(job.employmentType)}
Location${esc(job.location)}
Work Mode${esc(job.workMode)}
Salary / Stipend${esc(job.salaryOrStipend) || '—'}
Experience${esc(job.experienceRequired) || '—'}
Minimum CGPA${esc(job.minimumCGPA)}
Required Skills${list(job.requiredSkills)}
Application Deadline${esc(job.applicationDeadline) || '—'}
Job Description
${esc(job.jobDescription)}
Selection Process
${list(job.selectionProcess)}
Apply Now

Apply link: ${esc(job.applyLink)}

Regards,
${esc(job.companyName)}
Recruitment Team
`; return { json: Object.assign({}, d, { emailSubject: subject, emailHtml: html }) };
